title: Reading a record into a configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, let $d$ be a configuration on $k+2$ work tapes with record states, let $b$ be a Boolean record of length $4k+4$, and let $r$ be a natural number with $r\le 4k+4$. Replace the state by cursor position $r$ and the record that agrees with $b$ below position $r$ and is false at every position at least $r$. Increase the head position on the designated table tape by $r$; leave all other configuration data unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $d$ on $k+2$ work tapes with record states and input $x$
